commentary.text: 90+5' That's it for today, Victor Garcia has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+3' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Dani Olmo (Barcelona) heads on.
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.
90' 0 - 2 Goal - 0:2! Fermín tees up Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) inside the box and he curls the ball into the right side of the net and past Marko Dmitrovic.

89' Dani Olmo (Barcelona) has the opportunity to threaten the opponent's goal via a free kick on the edge of the box. He hits a fine strike towards the middle of the goal, but Marko Dmitrovic denies him with a great save.
88' Pol Lozano (Espanyol) makes an unfair challenge by holding his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball. A free kick has been awarded to Barcelona.
86' 0 - 1 Goal! Great play by Fermín releases Dani Olmo (Barcelona) in space on the edge of the box. He spots the keeper off his line and coolly puts the ball into the top right corner. 0:1.
82' Manolo Gonzalez has decided to substitute Pere Milla and he is replaced by Javi Puado (Espanyol).
82' Ramon Terrats (Espanyol) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Tyrhys Dolan.
82' Kike Garcia (Espanyol) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
79' Fermín (Barcelona) picks up a precise pass deep inside the box, but his strike is saved by the keeper.
77' Manolo Gonzalez isn't happy on the touchline after referee Victor Garcia shows him a yellow card.
77' Pol Lozano (Espanyol) picks up a yellow card for a foul.
77' Espanyol fail to score from a corner as Joan Garcia (Barcelona) leaps to collect the ball.

76' Carlos Romero (Espanyol) latches on to a precise pass and finds himself one-on-one with the keeper. He fires a low shot towards the right side of the net, but Joan Garcia leaps like a salmon to deny him. Espanyol will take a corner kick.
75' Substitution. Roberto Fernandez Jaen makes his way off the pitch and Kike Garcia (Espanyol) comes on as his replacement.
75' Pedri (Barcelona) trips an opposition player and Victor Garcia signals a foul.
73' Close! Pedri (Barcelona) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot inches wide of the right post.
72' Fermín (Barcelona) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.
71' Eric Garcia (Barcelona) finds himself some space to meet the corner and strikes the ball. He sends it towards the left post, but the goalkeeper makes a spectacular save to thwart him.
71' Barcelona win a corner.
70' The attendance is 36283.

70' Roberto Fernandez Jaen (Espanyol) receives a precise low pass inside the box, controls the ball and drills it towards the right post. Unfortunately for him, Joan Garcia makes a great save to stop his effort.

69' Roberto Fernandez Jaen (Espanyol) gathers a nice lofted pass deep inside the box and attempts to put the ball low into the middle of the goal, but his shot is deflected away by one of the defending players.

68' Jules Kounde (Barcelona) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Victor Garcia with no other option than to blow for a foul.
66' Flag goes up against Pol Lozano (Espanyol) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
64' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Raphinha as he is replaced by Dani Olmo (Barcelona).
64' Hansi Flick prepares a substitution. Gerard Martin is replaced by Pedri (Barcelona).
64' Substitution. Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) in, Ferran Torres out.
64' Jofre (Espanyol) threads a pass through the eye of a needle into the box for Roberto Fernandez Jaen, but Joan Garcia displays great awareness to stop him.
63' Barcelona have a corner.
63' Raphinha (Barcelona) steps up and sends the free kick straight into the defensive wall. Corner kick. Barcelona will have an opportunity.
62' Barcelona can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
61' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. Barcelona get a corner.
60' We are about to witness a substitution. Jofre (Espanyol) is replacing Exposito.
59' The foul by Roberto Fernandez Jaen (Espanyol) was seen by Victor Garcia who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.

59' Tyrhys Dolan (Espanyol) received a pass inside the box and sent a dangerous shot in on goal, but keep the champagne on ice as one of the defenders stepped in and blocked the effort. It's hard to say whether the keeper would have stopped it.
56' Roberto Fernandez Jaen (Espanyol) came close to scoring. He connected with a pass inside the box and perhaps should have done better than direct his shot straight at Joan Garcia.
54' The corner is swung in but Barcelona can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

54' What a great chance for Jules Kounde (Barcelona). He times his jump superbly when he leaps high to meet a precise cross from the corner, directing his towering header inside the right post, but the goalkeeper denies him with a miraculous save. Barcelona force their opponents to concede a corner.
54' Fermín (Barcelona) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.

53' He should have scored! Frenkie de Jong (Barcelona) gathered a short pass deep inside the box but took too long to shoot, allowing the defender to make the block. It will be a corner kick for Barcelona.
48' Pere Milla (Espanyol) failed to convert a mid-range free kick and sends the ball narrowly over the bar.
47' Eric Garcia (Barcelona) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul. Espanyol have been awarded a free kick.
46' Hansi Flick has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Fermín (Barcelona) comes on the pitch for Marcus Rashford.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+6' The match has reached half-time.
45+4' Omar El Hilali (Espanyol) brings his opponent down. Victor Garcia has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.
45+3' Jules Kounde (Barcelona) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball.

45+1' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) brilliantly evades multiple challenges and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the middle of the goal. It's a weak effort, however, and is easily saved by Marko Dmitrovic.
45' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
45' Eric Garcia (Barcelona) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing. Leandro Cabrera (Espanyol) is able to continue to play.
43' Looks like Eric Garcia (Barcelona) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
43' Leandro Cabrera (Espanyol) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.

42' Leandro Cabrera (Espanyol) outjumps the defence to meet the resulting corner and heads the ball towards the right side of the goal. The long-range header is not powerful enough, and the keeper comfortably makes a save.
42' Exposito (Espanyol) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
41' Roberto Fernandez Jaen (Espanyol) picks up an injury.

39' What a save from Joan Garcia! Carlos Romero (Espanyol) jumps high to meet a cross and glances a promising header from close range towards the roof of the net, but the goalkeeper pulls off a brilliant save to keep it out. The ball is out of play. Espanyol win a corner kick.
39' Pere Milla (Espanyol) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.

37' Ferran Torres (Barcelona) reacts well and displays good awareness near the penalty spot to get on the end of a cross from the free kick. He jumps high and produces a header which goes well wide of the left post.
36' Victor Garcia interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Pere Milla (Espanyol).
34' The current number of shots on goal is 1:0.
31' Eric Garcia (Barcelona) was too forceful with his tackle and Victor Garcia interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
28' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) makes a yard for himself inside the box after an accurate pass and takes a shot that goes just wide of the left post.
27' Roberto Fernandez Jaen (Espanyol) commits a rough foul. Victor Garcia stops the game and makes a call.
24' Alejandro Balde (Barcelona) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Victor Garcia has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
22' Barcelona have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
21' Pere Milla (Espanyol) reacts well to latch onto a rebound inside the box, but his shot is well blocked.
21' Great chance! Roberto Fernandez Jaen (Espanyol) collects a great pass inside the box, but the goalkeeper does well to stop his effort.
20' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) sends a cross into the box, but Marko Dmitrovic comes off his line to gather the ball.
17' The Barcelona players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.

13' What an amazing save by Marko Dmitrovic! Jules Kounde (Barcelona) swirls around the defenders and attempts to beat the keeper with a close-range shot low towards the middle of the target, but fails.
10' Leandro Cabrera (Espanyol) is penalised for a foul. Victor Garcia had a clear view and blows his whistle.
9' Corner kick. Exposito (Espanyol) is ready to send the ball into the box.

9' Exposito (Espanyol) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence. The ball goes out of play and Espanyol have been awarded a corner kick.
9' Leandro Cabrera (Espanyol) gets himself onto the end of the corner, but his header is blocked. Espanyol earn a corner.
8' Exposito (Espanyol) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
8' Fernando Calero (Espanyol) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender. The ball goes out of play. Espanyol are awarded a corner kick.

7' Marcus Rashford (Barcelona) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Victor Garcia blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion.
6' The game is interrupted as Alejandro Balde (Barcelona) is flagged offside.
5' Tyrhys Dolan (Espanyol) dribbles into space and finds himself in a shooting position, but his shot from the edge of the box is bravely blocked.
3' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) attempts to find Ferran Torres, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Barcelona will kick-off.
Victor Garcia is introduced as the referee for today's match.
